items.title: 一名14歲女童於馬鞍山失蹤 警方呼籲提供消息
items.summary: 一名女童在馬鞍山耀安邨最後露面後失蹤，警方呼籲市民提供消息。 警方表示，14歲女童蕭樂瑤星期三上午離開位於耀安邨的住所後便告失蹤，家人同日向警方報案。她身高約1.5米，體重約40公斤，瘦身材，尖面型，黃皮膚及蓄長黑髮，她最後露面時身穿白色恤衫、藍色短裙、深色外套、黑色皮鞋，以及攜有一個黑色背包。 警方呼籲任何人如有她的消息或曾見過她，請致電3661 1173或電郵至與新界南總區失蹤人口調查組，或與任何一間警署聯絡。 編輯：黃佩珊
items.titleEn: A 14-year-old girl disappeared in Mount Mayan, police called for information
items.summaryEn: The police have called on the public to provide information about the disappearance of a young girl after the last appearance of Ms. Yao An. Police said the 14-year-old girl was reported missing on Wednesday morning after leaving her home in Yangon, and her family reported her to the police the same day. She is about 1.5 meters tall, weighs about 40 kilograms, is thin, has a pointed face, has yellow skin and long black hair, and was last seen wearing a white shirt, blue shorts, black coat, black leather shoes, and a black backpack. Police urge anyone who has information about her or has seen her to call 3661 1173 or email the New South Wales District Missing Persons Investigation Unit or any police station. Editor's Note: This is the last post

items.titleEn: The Airline Authority has called for a permanent cancellation of the license of the elevator on the day of certification and requesting the advice of the Legal Affairs Department
items.summaryEn: A special meeting of the Legislative Development Committee (LDC) was held to discuss the installation of 720 fireproof lift door frames in the stand-up elevator. While working on the follow-up, General Aircraft Engineer at the Aircraft and Electrical Engineering Department, Liu Yuewa said that Taipei has submitted a repair plan, which was confirmed to be effective, and that the repair work on the two rooftops is expected to be completed in the month of Taipei, Japan, while the rest will be completed in two to three months. She stressed that the agency will carefully inspect every elevator, ensure compliance with the installation, and has been suspicious of alleged fraud and false statements about criminal activity. The Director of the Air and Electricity Agency, Ban Ki-moon, has said that while he is testifying and seeking the opinion of the Legal Affairs Department, he is likely to file a complaint and hold a disciplinary hearing, with the possibility of permanently revoking the license of the station. I'm not sure what to do.

items.title: 藥械監管中心條例草案刊憲 盧寵茂：推動香港成國際醫療創新樞紐

items.titleEn: Draft Regulations of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Regulations by Ru Ru Ruot Ma: Driving Hong Kong to become an international medical innovation hub
items.summaryEn: The draft regulation of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is published today and was first read by the legislature on 25th of this month. The draft mainly proposes the establishment of a pharmaceutical regulatory center as a legal entity to represent China in Hong Kong in international pharmaceutical regulation and the establishment of formal, long-term working relations with high-level international regulatory bodies. It is also proposed that, based on existing legislation, the current regulatory powers and functions, which will be distributed across multiple architectures and future legislation on medical devices, be transferred to the Directorate General of the National Health Service, the Unified Regulatory Framework. I'm not sure what to do.

items.title: 深圳APEC｜獲譽為「設計之都」 業界稱深圳文化配套齊全
items.summary: 即將舉行APEC峰會的深圳，被譽為「中國設計之都」。文化創意業亦是深圳四大支柱產業之一，佔全市GDP約8%。 有進駐園區的香港藝術家說，深圳文化配套齊全，創作概念能夠很快變成作品；亦有設計師舉辦非物質文化遺產展覽，希望讓更多參加峰會的人認識中國文化。 編輯：任順熙
items.titleEn: Shenzhen APEC has been dubbed the "design capital" by the industry for its cultural support.
items.summaryEn: Shenzhen, which will host the upcoming APEC summit, is known as "China's Design Capital". Cultural innovation is also one of the four pillars of Shenzhen, accounting for about 8% of the city's GDP. Hong Kong-based artists from the park said that Shenzhen's culture is well supported and creative concepts can quickly be transformed into works; and designers are organizing an exhibition of intangible cultural heritage, hoping to get more attendees to learn about Chinese culture.
